description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Wolverine Trading is a diversified financial institution specializing in proprietary trading, asset management, order execution services, and technology solutions. The Quantitative Developer will support options market making by developing experimentation pipelines, analyzing trading data, maintaining core datasets, and generating enhancements for trading features and parameters.
Quantitative developer building options market-making experiments, datasets, and post-trade analytics

Responsibilities:
• Gain domain expertise on US Equity Option exchange micro-structure
• Propose, run, and maintain production testing pipelines within an experimental framework
• Curate, document, and present experimentation results to trading and engineering staff
• Generate ideas for trading feature enhancement and parameter configurations through post trade analytics
• Work with large tick databases to build and maintain core datasets designed to increase team productivity and facilitate strategy enhancements

Requirements:
• Background in a quantitative field
• Knowledge of basic statistical concepts such as regression analysis
• Experience with Python and common data science packages
• A willingness to learn C#
• An understanding of or willingness to learn about low-level details relating to networking and FGPAs
• Strong technical and non-technical communication skills

Preferred:
• Experience with object-oriented programming
